entities.name: Gruffydd Maelor I
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gruffydd Maelor was a Prince of Powys Fadog in Wales. He married a daughter of King Owain Gwynedd, first Prince of Wales, and was a brother of Prince Owain Brogyntyn, ancestor of the Barons of Cymmer-yn-Edeirnion.
